title: the Weeping Wood Rising Revisited
author: Zephyrine Iversen
blurb: Jude Quintana, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
